About Us

We are proud of the clouds we build.

We love Linux. And networks. And clouds.

Storage systems for your cloud – check!

OpenStack for Businesses

Competent and personalized consulting for the perfect cloud infrastructure.

At socket, every customer is a long-term business partner. Get to know us!

Building the right cloud architecture should be exciting — and even fun. What works perfectly for one company might be completely unsuitable for another. That’s why we approach every project personally and collaboratively. The more we understand your requirements and business goals, the better we can help you design the perfect cloud architecture. Because for us, a strong relationship with our customers — our partners—is the key to success.

And what if something doesn’t go as planned?

Even the best cloud service providers face challenges. When hardware or software issues arise, we keep a cool head and promptly update you on what happened and the solutions we propose. As soon as you give the green light, we move straight to fixing the problem and restoring your cloud architecture’s stability. Transparency is our top priority—and we ask for the same openness from you.

Sensitive data – handled confidentially and well protected.

Building your cloud architecture often means working closely with your existing infrastructure. That requires a foundation of trust—which can’t just come from a polished website. At every step, we clearly explain what access we need, why, and what it means for you. You always have the option to ask questions or safeguard especially sensitive data.

Want to begin building trust? We do as well. Contact us by phone—no strings attached!

These are the questions we often hear...

What does socket do?

socket offers flexible solutions for your own cloud. We connect the cloud infrastructure to your network and storage systems or provide our own.

Which technology does socket use?

We fundamentally rely on open-source options. However, we also work with proprietary solutions upon request.

Where are socket's cloud solutions located?

The server infrastructure can be set up on our premises or in your own data center.

What happens after the server architecture is set up?

After the completion of every assignment, we hand over a well- structured documentation to you. This details all the prerequisites for successful operation. And lock-ins? They are guaranteed not to happen with us!
